entities.name: Benalia City
entities.description: Seaport capital of Benalia, razed in the Phyrexian Invasion, besieged by slivers, and rebuilt after the Mending.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation in the Domains of Dominaria whose capital is Benalia City.

entities.name: Council of Seven
entities.description: Ruling council of the seven clans, meeting in the Grand Hall.

entities.name: Clan Avenant
entities.description: Clan replacing the extinct Clan Ternsev.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: Church worshipping the planeswalker Serra; condemned in Benalia, regained legitimacy after the Mending.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: Phyrexian whose specialized killers first victimized Benalia.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion of Dominaria that razed Benalia City.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event after which Benalia City was rebuilt as New Benalia.

events.summary: Benalia is the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's specialized killers in the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Benalia was the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc 's specialized killers.

events.summary: At the invasion's peak in 4205 AR, Benalia City is razed and its people scattered.
events.quote: Benalia City was razed, and its people scattered.

events.summary: During the Time Spiral crisis, slivers besiege the city and it becomes a salt-choked ruin.
After the Mending the city is rebuilt as New Benalia and the Church of Serra regains legitimacy.
events.quote: the Church of Serra regained legitimacy
